risks.risk: Mechanical issues in gears, brakes, or engine not visible externally

risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified ownership, added risk discount

risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread and suspension components

risks.risk: Actual usage/mileage higher than claimed 6 months

proof_requests: Full side and rear view photos in daylight
Close-up of battery compartment and any wiring
Video of scooter starting and running, including gear shifts and brake test
Photo of purchase receipt or ownership/registration document
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a scooter/moped, so a worst-case price is possible, but the seller discloses a dead battery and makes multiple unverifiable claims about condition, originality, and mechanical function that must be priced conservatively until proven.
